semantics.kv_skap_vault: Maintains the verifier for the user and is the sole source of user-verification state.
semantics.stegos_device: An interchangeable StegOS transport node that may carry or execute bounded work. Device identity, node identity, transport channel identity, local key possession, and local hardware do not establish user-verifier authority and are not verification gates.
semantics.node_local_capability: A node may expose and invoke locally available capabilities after applicable KV/SKAP-backed user-verification state and Interlock/InTr admission are bound to the exact operation. Local execution does not make the node the user verifier.
semantics.transport_integrity: A transport may preserve integrity, freshness, routing, replay protection, and evidence bindings without becoming a user verifier or trust root for the user.
semantics.execution_surface_observation: Connector or runtime observations such as reachable, connected, alive, local, or unavailable describe execution-surface availability only. They never mean authorized, verified, trusted, user-verified, authority-bearing, substrate-unsuitable, or external-device-required.
semantics.device_interchangeability: Replacing one eligible StegOS device/node with another does not change the user's verifier. Only available local capability endpoints and resulting execution evidence may change.
semantics.remote_computer_transport: Remote Computer is a transport/discovery surface only. Capacity discovered through it may execute only after materializing as the canonical StegBrowser/StegOS node class and being admitted as ADMITTED-EPHEMERAL-STEGOS-NODE through Interlock/InTr.
semantics.ephemeral_substrate: Temporary compute is not a separate authority or durable machine dependency. Presence or connectivity grants no execution, transition, WorkerCoordinator claim/fence, credential, custody, publication, or completion authority.
semantics.runtime_substrate_order: Runtime-capable tasks must evaluate the canonical single-device-first substrate order before any remote/external-device last resort. EVIDENCE_REACHABILITY may remain pending but cannot establish UNSUITABLE or create an external-device requirement.
